Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning liability for damage to property owned by the department of transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liability for damage to property owned by thedepartment of transportation; and adding a new section to chapter 47.04RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning July 1, 2009, the department of fish and wildlife isliable for any damage to any public highway, bridge, elevatedstructure, or other property owned by the department of transportationsustained as the result of any direct action or inaction of thedepartment of fish and wildlife. Such damage to any public highway,bridge, elevated structure, or other property owned by the departmentof transportation may be recovered in a civil action instituted in thename of the state of Washington by the department of transportation.Any measure of damage determined by the department of transportation toits highway, bridge, elevated structure, or other property under thissection is prima facie the amount of damage caused by the direct actionor inaction of the department of fish and wildlife and is presumed tobe the amount recoverable in any civil action. The damages available p. 1 SB 6455under this section include the incident response costs, includingtraffic control, incurred by the department of transportation. Thissection may not be construed to conflict with RCW 43.17.330.
